description: Every comment on one LinkedIn post, fetched live: who commented (name, headline, profile_url, and followers, their LinkedIn follower count or null when unknown), what they said, and the replies under each comment. Works for any public post, not only the user's own. Use when they paste a LinkedIn post link and ask what people are saying, for a summary of the comments, or who commented. Pass the link exactly as given; feed/update links, share links and bare activity ids all work. When summarizing, cover the main themes, the overall sentiment, points of disagreement, and any notable commenters. If truncated is true, only the first comment_count comments were read, so say the summary covers those. In chat the comments also show as a sortable table under your reply, so never list them all out.

post.description: The LinkedIn post URL, urn:li:activity URN, or numeric activity id.

name: get_linkedin_post_comments
